Toyota Experience Center
The Experience Center features interactive displays, historical exhibits and a suspended Toyota Tundra you’ll have to see to believe.
Visit Now
Live
People of all ages and stages call Gibson County home.
Live More
Work
Advanced manufacturing and local small businesses alike thrive in Gibson County.
Work More
Visit
From bird watching to disc golf to boutique shopping, there’s much to explore in Gibson County.
Visit More
Learn
Whether pre-K or postgrad, Gibson County provides learning opportunities at every stage.
Learn More
Go Gibson and fully embrace everything that makes Gibson County, Indiana a fantastic place to Live, Work, Visit & Learn!
Whether you’re looking for the charm of small-town hospitality and scenic backroads, the growth of advanced manufacturing and local businesses, the diversity of historic locations, wildlife refuge, live entertainment, or the bright future of a complete learning pathway in public and private institutions, GoGibson has got you covered! This movement is about bringing together residents, visitors, local government, and businesses to celebrate what makes Gibson County such an extraordinary place to LIVE, WORK, VISIT and LEARN. Join us and experience all the wonders that Gibson County has to offer!
